shellCommands.command: mv middleware.ts proxy.ts && npm run build

npm run start &
PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i http://localhost:3000/
kill $PID

npm run build && npm run start &
PID=$!
sleep 4
curl -i http://localhost:3000/
kill $PID 2>/dev/null
mkdir -p middleware && echo "export * from '../proxy';" > middleware/index.ts && npm run build
